# Cenizo

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [redtide](../lore/worlds/redtide.md) · kind: new · stage: space · id: `cenizo`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** Dry Kiln plains, near sulfur fumaroles and fulgurite glass fields.
- **Diet:** Abiotic chemosynthesis mats, salt-fused glass shards, sulfur fumarole gas.
- **Active:** Staggered by thermal comfort; active when ground <310K, rests in shade of rocks.
- **Predators:** none

## Body

Armored hexagonal plates, fulgurite-cracker beak, heat-sink tail, flare-responsive pupils.

**Temperament:** Solitary, territorial, cautious near vents.
